capabilities: Insert tab staves into notes as fenced code blocks
Type frets, clear cells, and navigate beats and strings from the keyboard
Pick chord shapes and write them with a live preview
Switch staves between guitar and bass and change tunings
Configure default tunings, beats per measure, and chord shapes
extras: The manifest warns the plugin has not been manually reviewed by Obsidian staff. The README states the code was written with Claude Code and not reviewed line by line. Installation is manual (download main.js, manifest.json, styles.css from a release). The plugin makes no network requests.
problem: Obsidian has no way to type or align guitar and bass tab notation; writing tab by hand in plain text means manually keeping bars and beats lined up.
summary: Keyboard-driven editor for writing guitar and bass tablature in fenced code blocks, keeping tabs as plain text.
